description.value: The Chehalis River Hatchery, also known as the Chehalis River Salmonid Enhancement Facility, is a federally operated fish hatchery run by Fisheries and Oceans Canada's Salmonid Enhancement Program since 1982. Situated on Morris Valley Road in the Fraser Valley near Chilliwack, it focuses on rebuilding vulnerable Pacific salmon stocks in the Chehalis watershed. For a touring cyclist, it represents a working conservation facility that may offer interpretive interest as a roadside stop along rural Morris Valley Road.
